Subject: Intro + quick pre-demo questions

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the invite. We signed up last week and would love a short walkthrough of Redwood to validate fit. A few quick items so we can make the most of the session:

- Primary use case: inference for a customer-support assistant (hybrid retrieval + generation). Will likely run multistep prompts + embeddings.
- Typical traffic today: ~30k messages/month, bursty (peaks ~150 reqs/min).
- Expected ramp: pilot in ~6 weeks, 10x if pilot looks good.
- Compliance note: we need to know about private deployment options (VPC + KMS).

Can you share one or two 30–45 min slots early next week? We’re PST-based (San Francisco). Attendees will include our infra lead (Alex).

Samir

Ben / Laura — forwarding Samir from Cartify (inbound signup). They have a retrieval+generation support assistant use case and a bursty profile. Before I propose live slots, can you help confirm the following and suggest three candidate windows (30–45m) next Tue/Wed? Prefer PST morning if possible.

Quick asks to validate:
- Confirm if RD can show an embeddings retrieval demo + short gen flow in 30m (yes/no).
- For peak ~150 reqs/min: what model variant / instance mix would we suggest for a pilot (low-latency preference)? Rough token/sec guidance is fine.
- Any obvious blockers for VPC/KMS discussion in a basic demo (we should surface Enterprise packaging only if ops asks).

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro + quick pre-demo questions — candidate windows

Rishi —

Quick answers inline and a suggested outreach note to send Samir:

- Embeddings + gen in 30m: yes — we can demo a retrieval + contextual generation walkthrough, but call out that deep production routing (dedicated pools / autoscale policies) is enterprise follow-up.
- Peak 150 reqs/min: pilot recommendation = 2x mid-range GPU workers with batching/kv-cache on; show a lower-cost variant (int8/quant) if latency tolerance exists. Rough estimate: ~12–18 reqs/sec per worker depending on prompt length — I'll include caveats in the call.
- VPC/KMS: no blocker for a discovery/demo; avoid moving into procurement until they confirm SSO/KMS needs. Ops lead (Alex) can be looped for a tech deep-dive.

Suggested message to Samir (I can send from my account or you can):

• Tue Jul 20 — 9:00–9:45am
• Tue Jul 20 — 11:00–11:45am
• Wed Jul 21 — 8:30–9:15am

- Ramp: pilot (6 weeks) -> production Q4 if pilot ok; projected steady state ~300k messages/month in six months.
